about: IPMA's weather warnings for the Lisbon district (idAreaAviso LSB), non-green only; red and orange warnings elsewhere; and how Lisbon's warnings changed over time. Times are local = UTC (WET). IPMA's open data carries no issue time: `sent_utc` is the sent time of the CAP message (MeteoAlarm, cap.json) matching the warning's area, type, level and window exactly, or null where none matches (never guessed).

history.event: IPMA communiqué no. 1 names the low CHARLES; says orange warnings will be issued for the mainland, an upgrade not ruled out; worse weather 'a partir do final da manhã do dia 11'.
ANEPC public warning Aviso 21 on CHARLES (gusts to 120 km/h; avoid unnecessary travel). Civil protection's, not IPMA's.

IPMA's warnings update 'divulgada às 08h31 de terça-feira': red wind for eight mainland districts on Wednesday; Lisbon red wind 12:00 to 21:00, gusts to 120 km/h, up to 140 km/h in the most exposed places (Lusa, as published by AWAY at 08:46 UTC). The first public time for Lisbon's red wind found so far.
The government's alert situation for the mainland on Wednesday cites IPMA: gusts that may reach 120 km/h and, if a sting jet forms, above 150 km/h.
IPMA warnings read: Lisbon red wind Wed 12:00-21:00; rain orange Wed (05:00 onwards); sea orange Wed 12:00-21:00; a yellow sea warning added Wed 21:00-Thu 03:00.
IPMA communiqué no. 2: worse weather on the mainland 'a partir do início da manhã do dia 11' (moved earlier from late morning); red and orange warnings issued; further upgrades not ruled out.
IPMA raises Lisbon rain to RED Wed 12:00-18:00 (orange now 05:00-12:00 only). First read at 17:42.

history.event: IPMA sends a wind warning message for Lisboa (CAP id ...PT.261109132716.PO-01-1906), the one the red wind later replaced; its level is not in the feed any more (superseded).
IPMA SENDS the RED wind warning for Lisboa, Wed 12:00-21:00 (CAP id ...PO-01-1915, an update of the 9 Nov 13:27:16 message). This is the issue time; press reported it from 08:31.
IPMA sends the ORANGE sea warning for Lisboa, Wed 12:00-21:00 (update of a 07:18:40 message).
IPMA sends the message that made Lisbon's rain RED (12:00-18:00): its sent time, as named in the 21:23 update's references. Open data showed it between 16:52 and 17:42.
IPMA sends updates for Lisboa: RED rain moved earlier to Wed 09:00-18:00 (was 12:00-18:00); ORANGE rain Wed 00:00-09:00 (was 05:00-12:00); YELLOW rain Tue 21:24-Wed 00:00.
IPMA's open data (warnings_www.json) first shows the 21:23 change: it lagged the CAP messages by at least 2 h (reads at 22:04, 22:23 and 23:22 still had the old rain warnings).
